examples.text: 1박 팀 아직 도착도 안 했는데 너는 그런 소식을 어디서 그렇게 재빠르게 접했냐?
examples.trans: The 2 Days & 1 Night team has not even arrived back yet—where did you pick up that news so fast?
Here the word for 'even arrival' is key.

meanings.en: earlier, a short while ago (same day)

examples.trans: I called earlier.
What did you say earlier?

그러다.gloss: to say so; to do so

meanings.en: to say so; to speak like that
meanings.note: contracted from 그러하다; often follows quoted speech

meanings.en: to do so; to act like that

examples.trans: Who said that?
That friend also said they are going together.

meanings.note: adverbial form of 빠르다 (to be fast)

examples.trans: Please get ready quickly.
Time goes by so fast.

meanings.note: Humble equivalent of 부탁하다.

examples.trans: I kindly ask this favor of you.
I asked for help.

meanings.note: Used when repeating an action.

examples.trans: See you again!
It is raining again.
